thought.text: Penting: free tier = **"API Access (pay with credits)"** — bukan $1 kredit API gratis. $1 tadi mungkin untuk chat web. Saya cek API key dan kredit sebenarnya.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && for p in "/api/v1/api_keys" "/api/v1/api-keys" "/api/v1/billing/balance" "/api/v1/credits" "/api/v1/me"; do printf "%-28s " "$p"; curl -s --max-time 25 "https://api.venice.ai$p" -w " [%{http_code}]" | head -c 120; echo; done; echo "=== docs api key ==="; curl -s --max-time 30 "https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/api-keys" -o /tmp/vd.html -w "[%{http_code}] "; grep -oiE "(api key|credits|free|\\\$[0-9]+)[^<]{0,80}" /tmp/vd.html | sort -u | head -8

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && for p in \"/api/v1/api_keys\" \"/api/v1/api-keys\" \"/api/v1/billing/balance\" \"/api/v1/credits\" \"/api/v1/me\"; do printf \"%-28s \" \"$p\"; curl -s --max-time 25 \"https://api.venice.ai$p\" -w \" [%{http_code}]\" | head -c 120; echo; done; echo \"=== docs api key ===\"; curl -s --max-time 30 \"https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/api-keys\" -o /tmp/vd.html -w \"[%{http_code}] \"; grep -oiE \"(api key|credits|free|\\\\\\$[0-9]+)[^<]{0,80}\" /tmp/vd.html | sort -u | head -8", "summary": "Probe Venice API key endpoints", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 180}
